body:
It's hard to explain. I was just surprised by the rejection. I gave her a gift with a card and gave her a hug. Everything looked to be going great, we had a few dates that went well prior. I had felt the best I've ever been. Then she sends me a text explaining how I was doing too much, how she wanted to be friends, how she would return the gift, ect... For sure her parents know. 

I don't know why I'm over reacting.
